# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P07.4 — Access без AzGuard и мост access-azguard

**Intent:** Сделать `corex-access` самостоятельным: права вычисляются собственной матрицей ролей и прямыми grants, компиляция матрицы публикует событие, а вся интеграция с AzGuard уходит в новый пакет-мост `axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard`, исключённый из релизного набора до публикации AzGuard.

**Why:** D14, D96 B (п.6–п.7); AzGuard не опубликован (W7), а access тянет его через package-репозиторий на приватный VCS, что D16 запрещает релизному пакету; `research/04-architecture.md` §9 называет мост.

**Scope Included:** `DefaultAccessChecker::allowed()` по examples §9; `DirectGrantLookup` на `aut_direct_grants`; миграция `aut_direct_grants`; `DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler` без AzGuard + событие `CoreX\Access\Matrix\Events\RoleMatrixCompiled` (Api); `PrincipalIdentity` без AzGuard-контрактов; registrars, config и `AuthOptions` access без AzGuard; миграция `aut_roles` без `azguard_role_id`; новый пакет `packages/access-azguard` (composer, provider, registrar, перенос пяти AzGuard-классов, слушатель `SyncAzGuardRolePermissions`, миграция `aut_azguard_role_links`, config pins, Blade-директивы, тесты, README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG); `scripts/manifest-check.py` `UNRELEASED`; `scripts/ownership-map.json`, glossary §Packages, `docs/architecture/table-ownership.md`; CI-шаги и `test:packages` для моста; тесты `NativePermissionTest`, `AzGuardBridgeTest`; Golden delta P07.4.

**Scope Excluded:** публикация AzGuard и включение моста в релиз (owner-gate Q2, P09); перенос данных из `az_guard_direct_grants` (ничего не опубликовано, D01); изменение scope-предикатов (guards активности в scopeFor/canOnRecord/query apply включены по D98); baseline схемы (P08).

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D100-p07-grok-design-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D98-p07-design-audit-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md` (B) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D14-access-azguard.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` (§1.4, §2, §3.4, §4, §5) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design-rag.md` (W7) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` (§9–§11) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/facts/azguard-coupling.txt` · результат P07.3 (`plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.3-execution/completion.md`, появляется после его исполнения)

**Files:** `scripts/package-graph-gate.php` (VALID_STABILITY), `docs/architecture/taxonomy.md` (§Stability); `packages/access/CHANGELOG.md`; `packages/access/src/Access/Internal/{DefaultAccessChecker,DefaultScopeResolver,DirectGrantLookup}.php`; `packages/access/src/Matrix/Internal/DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Internal/Models/Role.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Data/RoleView.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Laravel/RoleMatrixData.php`; `packages/access/src/Matrix/Events/RoleMatrixCompiled.php` (новый); `packages/access/src/Access/Laravel/PrincipalIdentity.php`; `packages/access/src/Laravel/{AccessBindingsRegistrar,AccessIntegrationRegistrar}.php`; `packages/access/src/{Access/Internal/AutMatrixGrantSource,Access/Internal/WorkspacePermissionLayer,Matrix/Internal/MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder,Matrix/Laravel/AzGuardRoleModel,Tenancy/Internal/TenantContextGuard}.php` (перенос в мост); AuthOptions и `packages/access/config/corex-access.php`; `packages/access/database/migrations/tenant/2026_07_26_200001_create_aut_roles_table.php`, `packages/access/database/migrations/tenant/2026_10_04_000001_create_aut_direct_grants_table.php` (новая); `packages/access/composer.json`, `packages/access/{README,PACKAGE}.md`, `packages/access/phpstan-baseline.neon`; `packages/access/tests/**` (AzGuard-тесты → мост; `NativePermissionTest` новый); `packages/access-azguard/**` (новый пакет); `composer.json` (root: require-dev моста, `test:packages`), `composer.lock` (только path-пакет моста); `scripts/manifest-check.py`, `scripts/ownership-map.json`; `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/03-glossary.md`; `docs/architecture/table-ownership.md`; `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; `packages/{access,access-azguard}/resources/contracts/php-api.json`; `tests/Golden/baseline/*` (строки P07.4 из §4); `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.4-execution/**`.

**Required Reads:** 1) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` §1.4, §3.4; 2) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` §9–§11; 3) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md`; 4) `packages/access/src/Access/Internal/DefaultAccessChecker.php`; 5) `packages/access/src/Matrix/Internal/DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Internal/Models/Role.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Data/RoleView.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Laravel/RoleMatrixData.php`; 6) `packages/access/src/Laravel/AccessBindingsRegistrar.php`; 7) `packages/access/composer.json`; 8) `scripts/manifest-check.py`.

**Implementation Rules:** D98 п.8–9: EntityActivity guards before any grant/memo; bridge owns role links, public RoleMatrixData/EntityActivity only; no foreign Internal. RoleView/RoleMatrixData public delta in Golden/changelog. В `packages/access` после item нет ни одной ссылки на AzGuard, кроме CHANGELOG. Оценка fail-closed: неизвестная сущность, отсутствующая роль, scope `none`, чужой workspace, истёкший или отозванный grant → false. Перенос классов в мост — `git mv` с правкой namespace; поведение AzGuard-интеграции сохраняется (sync `az_guard_role_permissions` в одной транзакции). D100: закрытый набор graph/taxonomy/manifest получает пятое значение `unreleased`; `stability: unreleased` допустим только для имён из `UNRELEASED`. Без алиасов (D01). Manifest и changelog каждого затронутого пакета — в одном продуктовом commit; base SHA — до правок.

**Code Guidance:** Досье §3.4 шаги 1–7; examples §9 (allowed и worked example), §10 (миграция и table-ownership), §11 (composer моста, manifest-check и негатив, слушатель синхронизации).

**Validation:**
- После продуктового commit: `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh` и `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh "$(cat plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.4-execution/base-commit.txt)"` → exit 0.
- `git grep -n -i -E 'azguard|az_guard' -- packages/access ':!packages/access/CHANGELOG.md'` → пусто.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/access test` и `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/access test:pg` → exit 0, включая `NativePermissionTest` (examples §9: stale matrix/direct grant на unknown/inactive entity отказывает во всех четырёх paths) без установленного AzGuard в closure access.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/access-azguard test` → exit 0 (`AzGuardBridgeTest`: после `RoleMatrixCompiled` `az_guard_role_permissions` совпадает с матрицей; связь в `aut_azguard_role_links`, чистая схема без aut_roles.azguard_role_id, rollback listener, отсутствие foreign Internal).
- `scripts/php84 composer package-graph-gate`, `scripts/php84 composer manifests:check`, `scripts/php84 composer ownership-gate`, `scripts/php84 composer table-ownership-gate`, `scripts/php84 composer naming-gate` → exit 0; негативы examples §11: mystery отклоняют оба gate, foreign unreleased отклоняет manifest-check; bridge unreleased проходит graph; вернуть.
- `scripts/php84 composer test:packages`, `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer test:pg` → exit 0.
- `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --write` дважды → идентично; `scripts/php84 composer php-api`, `scripts/php84 composer bc-check` → exit 0; diff Golden — только строки P07.4 из досье §4.
- `scripts/php84 composer lint:check`, `scripts/php84 composer analyse`, `scripts/php84 composer deps:analyse` → exit 0; `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh` → exit 0; `php scripts/package-docs-gate.php` → exit 0.
- Review `light` (D97): self-check по досье §6; строка `review: self-check GREEN` в Completion Notes.

**Deliverables:** package changelogs; `artifacts/P07.4-execution/base-commit.txt` и candidate SHA; access без AzGuard; `aut_direct_grants`; `RoleMatrixCompiled`; пакет `access-azguard` со своими тестами; manifest-check `UNRELEASED`; обновлённые ownership-map, glossary, table-ownership, CI; Golden delta P07.4; `artifacts/P07.4-execution/completion.md`.

availableCommands.name: bundled:review
availableCommands.description: Run a reviewer subagent against your whole branch vs main, your uncommitted working state, a named branch, a single GitHub PR, or an entire Graphite/stacked-PR stack (one reviewer subagent per PR). A bare /review defaults to reviewing your uncommitted working state when the tree is dirty, or your whole branch vs main when the tree is clean. Main, local, and branch modes write a review file plus a summary to disk. PR and stack modes post the findings as a PENDING GitHub review for the user to inspect and submit through the UI. Use --main for an explicit clean-tree branch review, --stack for stacked PRs, --submit to publish immediately as COMMENT, or --approve to publish and approve; the default remains PENDING.
